note: SPEC v4 F1: the Seixo case, variant B, as modelled in case/case.py. Coordinates: x right from the case's leftmost point, y from the back (0) to the player (100), z up from the table, mm.

controls.logo_kind: straight (horizontal), centred in the interface's back zone, engraved

pot.kind: 9 mm switched pot, horizontal type (PECAS volume_pot), on a vertical board right of its shaft; M7 bushing nutted on the lid

controls_board.note: hangs under the lid on 2 M2 posts; the pot board meets its left edge at 90 deg

speaker.note: rim on a foam gasket under the 13 deg lid, inside a locating ring; sealed back box: walls from the lid, glued floor

battery.kind: LiPo 1S 1000 mAh 603450 with PCM and NTC (3 wires), PECAS battery
battery.note: bay on the bottom plate (walls + roof), off the main board; out through a hatch in the bottom, the lid stays shut

stack.note: LOW stack (Teensy soldered straight on the Audio Board), 3 mm above the main board; u along the 38 mm side from the USB end

panel.note: USB-C + 3.5 jack on one board on the back-left curved wall (flat boss inside); see pcb_envelope.json panel

main_board.note: = case/out/pcb_envelope.json outline (the bay's corner left out)

case.files: case/out/seixo_tampa, seixo_fundo, seixo_tampa_bateria, seixo_caixa_fundo, plate, keycap_natural/sharp/cf, keycap_test_4 (.step/.stl)

seixo_tampa.what: casca de cima: logo de 0,4, grade, furos dos knobs, janelas do USB-C e do fone

seixo_fundo.what: fundo com os pilares da placa e o berço da bateria

seixo_caixa_fundo.what: fundo da caixa do alto-falante, colado e vedado

keycap_cf.what: capas de Dó e Fá, xadrez diagonal em relevo

keycap_test_4.what: teste: 4 capas num canal, antes das 28
